assessment: This study reveals how selective degradation of peroxisomes via autophagy (pexophagy) is repressed under unstressed conditions; the peroxisomal AAA+ ATPase complex binds to the pexophagy protein Atg36 to inhibit its phosphorylation by the casein kinase Hrr25, which triggers pexophagy. Thus, this work unveils a novel aspect in pexophagy regulation and provides mechanistic insights into the regulation of other selective autophagy pathways and other intracellular quality control systems.
